youtube.title: AI Receptionist for Plumbing Business Owners: Count Missed Calls First (Part 1 of 2)
youtube.description:
AI receptionist for plumbing, HVAC and electrical business owners: count missed calls first, part 1 of 2.
Source: our worked example in 01_voice/facts.json, labeled EXAMPLE on screen and not a real shop or customer: 14 missed calls in 2 weeks; 4 were real jobs; $350 cleared a job. 4 x $350 = $1,400 in 2 weeks; call it $2,800 a month.

Steps:
1. For 2 weeks, mark every missed call on a calendar.
2. Circle the ones that were real jobs.
3. Multiply real jobs by what you clear on an average job.
4. Hold that monthly value next to the monthly price on the quote. A bigger price can't pay for itself from missed calls yet.

Next: part 2 tries 3 options side by side: a missed-call text-back, a person answering, and an AI receptionist.
